lines.en: I swim with my tail sweeping.
I move close to the sandy bottom.
The current pushes; I go with it.
I pass through the water weeds.
I swim along the bank's shadow.

lines.zh: 我转身很快，尾一摆就行
lines.en: I turn quickly, one flick of the tail.
I rise a little.
I head for that bit of light on the surface.
I glide past a stone.
I follow the current around a bend.
I swim low, hugging the bottom.
I beat my tail twice, quick.
I pass beneath a sunken log.

lines.zh: 水面上有影子，我下去了
lines.en: A shadow on the surface; I sink.
I swim slowly along the shallows.
I stop between the stones.
I hang midwater, fins barely moving.

lines.zh: 马拉瓜的鱼，藏在水草里。
lines.en: A Guapote hides among the water weeds.
Sunlight wavers on the bottom.
I watch something floating above.
My scales shine in the light.
The weeds sway beside me.
I sweep my tail once, slowly.
These are stones I know.
Silt rises from the bottom.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底的沙，顺着水流走。
lines.en: Along the riverbed sand, I follow the current.
The ripples above are confused.
I don't like water that's too bright.
I sink half a foot deeper.
A small fish passes before me.
You're on the bank; I'm in the water.
I surface and take one look at you.
Your shadow falls into the water.
I swim around the edge of it.
You bend down; I sink away.
I watch you through the surface.
Reach in and I'll dart off.
In this water, I decide.
Your boot has touched the water.

lines.zh: 我绕着你泡在水里的脚。
lines.en: I circle the foot you've dipped in the water.
One tail beat and I dart away.
The water churns around me.

lines.zh: 鳞掉了好几片，水里发凉。
lines.en: Several scales gone, the water feels cold.
Blood threads in the water; I dive into the weeds.
I press to the bottom and keep still.
I retreat a little deeper.
I can still swim with this.
I gape for breath in the crevice.
The water hides my shape.
I go still among the weeds.
Let me check what sank down there.
Hugging the riverbed, I edge closer.
First I circle it halfway.
That smell isn't from the water.
I open my mouth, then close it.
I touch it once and back off.
Wrong taste; I spit it out.
Drop it in and I'll look.
Your hand jerks, and the water splashes.
I nudge it against a stone.
One sweep of my tail and I'm gone.
You stepped in and hit me.
I slide past your leg.
The water takes most of the force.
I roll and steady myself.
One tail flick, and I hide in the reeds.
I hit a stone and slide off.
In water this shallow, hiding is hard.
You step back, and the water clears.
That bump missed; I turn and try again.
You're in the water too.
Two sets of ripples on the surface.
I circle you once.
This stretch of bottom is enough for both.
You go up; I'll go down.
Deeper water is safer.
I sweep my tail, and you sweep yours.

lines.zh: 这两块石头之间，是我们的
lines.en: Between these stones is ours.
Don't swim too near the bank.
Let's wait for dark together.
One gulp, and my scales flash.
I hold it in my mouth.
Too hard; I spit it out.
I carry it back behind a stone.
I'll try anything in the water.
This mouthful has sand in it.
It slips out of my mouth.
I press it to the bottom.
I don't much like this.
Let me see if there's more.
A shadow on the surface; I look up.
I stop behind a stone.
The surface is churning.
I rise slowly.
It's at the water's edge.
I know this pool; no need to rush.
I sweep my tail once.
I hold behind the rock.
I sink low among the water weeds.
The gap is closing.
A guapote's scales shine blue.

lines.zh: 丽体鱼的斑纹，一闪就动。
lines.en: The guapote's markings flash, and it moves.
I drift closer with the current.
The surface hides my shadow.
It hasn't moved.

lines.zh: 我再靠近一点，河湾的石头下有虫。
lines.en: A little closer; insects under the river bend stones.
In the weeds, only my gills move.
It's stepped nearer the water.
That's just the chance I want.
I advance along the bottom.
I'm an arm's length away.
It's looking down at the water.
I change angle and rise.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子晃动起来
lines.en: The shadow on the surface wavers.

lines.zh: 我把嘴对准了它的方向
lines.en: I aim my mouth at where it is.
I lash my tail and lunge.
I bite into it.
The splash reached the bank.
I shake my head and drag it waterward.
It's retreated up the bank.
I stop where the water thins.
I circle once in the water.
There's blood on my scales.
I don't pursue further.
The water settles again.
I dart in, then fall back.
It steps half a pace up the bank.

lines.zh: 我在水里慢慢显出身形
lines.en: I take shape in the water.

lines.zh: 第一口气是从水里吸的
lines.en: My first breath came from the water.
One tail beat and I swim off.

lines.zh: 这里的水比我记得的浅
lines.en: The water here is shallower than I recall.
I find my way along the bottom.
There's light on the surface, dazzling.
I circle a stone.
My gills open; I begin to breathe.
The weeds block me; I pass through.
I hear movement on the bank.
I sink and hide first.
The bottom is safer than above.
I edge slowly toward the bank.
I see a shadow on the surface.

lines.zh: 水面上的火烤得我发烫
lines.en: Fire on the surface heats the water.

lines.zh: 我从水里被甩上岸，摔得发懵
lines.en: I'm flung out onto the bank and lie dazed.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，水面还差一点。
lines.en: Mouth open, the surface is still too far.
The blast throws the water up.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎穿了我的鳍
lines.en: Something sharp pierces my fin.
This force turns the water cold.

lines.zh: 许久没吃东西，我没力气
lines.en: Long without food, I've no strength.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我全身一麻
lines.en: Lightning hits the water; I go numb.
The water is gone, and I fall.
